summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress of its ongoing share buyback program announced October 30, 2025. Under the program, up to EUR 30 million of shares may be repurchased. In the week June 8–12, 2026, the company bought 64,272 shares at an average price of EUR 5.71 per share, totaling EUR 366,971. No advisor or special board recommendation is mentioned, and no premium, tender offer, or going-private transaction is involved. There are no regulatory hurdles; this is an ordinary-course open-market repurchase. As such, this is a routine capital return disclosure, not a special situation.
